- KLM-PHASE-7 · phase · - · - · docs/sas/KnightLM_SAS.md:1
- KLM-SAS · spec · - · KnightLM — Software Architecture Specification · docs/sas/KnightLM_SAS.md:1
- KLM-SAS-98 · section · - · Implementation phases · docs/sas/KnightLM_SAS.md:60
- KLM-SAS-106 · section · - · Architecture requirements index · docs/sas/KnightLM_SAS.md:147
- KLM-SAS-RQ-001 · requirement · - · This SAS is accepted by a human signature and every Warrant pins the accepted revision · docs/sas/KnightLM_SAS.md:154
- KLM-SAS-RQ-002 · requirement · - · Every Warrant is authorized and resolved by a human, never by the performer · docs/sas/KnightLM_SAS.md:155
- KLM-SAS-RQ-003 · requirement · - · Every resolution rests on an independent verification and recorded gate evidence · docs/sas/KnightLM_SAS.md:156
- KLM-SAS-RQ-004 · requirement · - · Every supported notation normalizes to the canonical GameRecord/GameState or fails explicitly; nothing is silently repaired or invented · docs/sas/KnightLM_SAS.md:157
- KLM-SAS-RQ-005 · requirement · - · Every supported export format round-trips: state, export, ingest, identical canonical state, proven on fixtures · docs/sas/KnightLM_SAS.md:158
- KLM-SAS-RQ-006 · requirement · - · Every GameRecord carries source and history_complete as source assertions; a four-field FEN source never yields history_complete true · docs/sas/KnightLM_SAS.md:159
- KLM-SAS-RQ-007 · requirement · - · Standard chess and Chess960/DFRC are first-class in ingest, replay, facts and export, in both UCI castling flavors · docs/sas/KnightLM_SAS.md:160
- KLM-SAS-RQ-008 · requirement · - · The viewer is Rust-only, Leptos and axum compiled to WASM, with no JavaScript or TypeScript in the application · docs/sas/KnightLM_SAS.md:161
- KLM-SAS-RQ-009 · requirement · - · An engine is reachable only as teacher labeler, post-decision scorer or opponent; the model's inference path never queries an engine · docs/sas/KnightLM_SAS.md:162
- KLM-SAS-RQ-010 · requirement · - · The player is exposed as a UCI engine, and an illegal model move is a reported failure, never silently corrected · docs/sas/KnightLM_SAS.md:163
- KLM-SAS-RQ-011 · requirement · - · Training corpora carry provenance and pass split audits before use; teacher labels are recorded as labels only · docs/sas/KnightLM_SAS.md:164
- KLM-SAS-RQ-012 · requirement · - · Model ability is reported per scoring axis with bounded evidence; no composite winner score and no scored free prose · docs/sas/KnightLM_SAS.md:165
- KLM-SAS-RQ-013 · requirement · - · A Burn-native model is admitted only through the parity gates, with reset isolation between inference passes · docs/sas/KnightLM_SAS.md:166
- KLM-SAS-130 · section · - · Disciplines · docs/sas/KnightLM_SAS.md:168
